candidates.desc: At an outdoor race ceremony with palm trees and bunting, an official takes a gold medal on a striped ribbon from a case and hangs it around a sweaty runner's neck. She lifts the medal, stares at it in disbelief, playfully bites it and then throws her arms up cheering.

Sprinters in bright kit crouch in starting blocks on a stadium track, burst out together and sprint down the straight. The leader breaks the finish tape and the group slows, laughing and hugging each other.

At a village vegetable show a judge carries a rosette with long blue, red and yellow ribbons past the entries and pins the blue prize ribbon onto a giant pumpkin; the young grower gasps and hugs her winning pumpkin while the crowd claps.

A women's indoor soccer team in blue jerseys sprints toward a golden cup waiting on a stand in a packed arena. One player lifts the trophy over her head screaming with joy, then the whole team hoists it together under falling confetti while the crowd cheers.

In an animated mud obstacle race, a muddy woman in an orange top strains ahead of two rivals and breaks the white finish tape first. She screams with joy, receives a gold trophy, kisses it and is lifted on her competitors' shoulders under falling confetti.

A swimming race in an indoor pool. A row of swimmers launch off the starting blocks together, but one swimmer is left standing alone on his block. An official on the poolside waves an arm at him, he goes into the water and swims a length, then climbs out at the wall, picks up his goggles and walks away along the tiles looking furious.

An extreme close-up of a wide-open eye opens the clip. Friends in a living room sit facing each other in pairs, nose to nose, eyes stretched wide, each trying to outlast the other without shutting their eyes. One pair after another is shown straining. Finally somebody loses, and the whole room bursts out laughing and points at the loser.

A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.

A short montage of young people finishing hard things. A woman in leggings hangs high on an indoor climbing wall and reaches for the last hold at the top. A young man in a gym drives a loaded barbell up out of a deep front squat, straining. A runner in black crosses a finish line on a red track with both arms thrown up and her mouth open in a shout while spectators watch. A young man in a sports hall presses the last piece into a big floor puzzle and beams straight at the camera. A woman finishes a set of floor exercises on a turf pitch, and finally a group of athletes crowd into a selfie with their fists raised, all shouting in celebration.

A woman in an orange race vest with a number bib runs along a grey waterfront promenade on a cold overcast day. She takes a white paper cup, drinks from it while still running, then glances down at the watch on her wrist. In the last seconds she comes down the closed-off finishing straight past an orange cone, spectators packed behind metal barriers clapping her in, and crosses the blue finish line with her arms lifted, a second runner far behind her.

At a skatepark at sunset, a young man in a white vest and black shorts stands on top of a three-step concrete block like a winner's podium, one fist raised and a skateboard held high, shouting with joy, then lifts the skateboard over his head with both hands. On the lower left step a young man in a blue T-shirt claps, and on the right step a young woman in a mustard top pats his leg. Skateboards and a water bottle lie on the ground, with palm trees and a clear blue sky.

On an ice rink in a packed arena, a young male figure skater in a black top and trousers bows deeply in the middle of the ice while red roses fly through the air and land around him. He straightens up, turns his back and spreads his arms wide toward the crowd. Behind the white barrier a large crowd stands and claps, some holding scarves and flags, under bright ceiling lights. Red roses lie scattered on the ice around his skates.

On a wet cobbled market square under dark storm clouds, a small white car stands on the edge of a stone fountain, with water spraying over its roof and the driver's door open. Inside, a young woman at the wheel hides her face in her hands, while a serious examiner in a blue shirt and tie in the passenger seat holds up a sheet with a big red cross. She lowers her hands and stares ahead in defeat. Market stalls with striped umbrellas and shoppers stand around the square.

A jockey in a green silk shirt with white stars and a white helmet rides a grey horse along the white rail of the parade ring at a crowded racecourse on a grey day, led by a man in a dark jacket. Jockeys in bright silks on brown horses follow behind. As the grey horse walks closer, a huge crowd pressed against the rail, many in green and white scarves and rosettes, holds up phones and cameras towards it. A packed grandstand and bare trees stand behind.

On the wet deck of a rusty fishing boat at sea under a cloudy sky, a young woman with a long braid in an orange waterproof jacket and overalls throws her arms wide in amazement as a huge net above her releases a flood of silver fish. The fish pour down and pile up around her legs while she shouts. Seagulls circle above. On the next boat, men in orange overalls and dark caps lean on the rail and stare, one holding up a single small fish in his hand.
